about: Every line of text the player sees.

rows.text: A Geometry Dash portal hums here. Press UP to enter.
Stereo Madness! You're the turnip now. JUMP to jump (hold in the ship). R restarts.
Turnip Mountain! Hold ATTACK for your left hand and DASH for your right, steer with the arrows, and swing to the top.
Turnip Dash runs inside Hollow Knight.
Turnip Dash couldn't find Geometry Dash. Install it on Steam, or set TURNIPDASH_GD_DIR to its folder, then re-enter the portal.
Turnip Dash couldn't find Turnip Mountain. Install it on Steam, or set TURNIPDASH_TM_DIR to its folder, then re-enter the portal.
Turnip Mountain was found, but its turnip art could not be read from it (details in ModLog.txt). Using a plain marker.
